calls.why: Nothing new has been logged since yesterday's review, so yesterday's call stands: tonight uses the app's own deload numbers. This lift has not earned a step anyway. On 19 Sept he went up to 165 and the last set dropped to 5 reps, below the 6-rep floor. His best since July is 180 x 8 on 27 Aug. He has not done this lift at the Warsaw gym yet, so that machine has no number.

Nothing new logged, so this repeats yesterday's call and tonight uses the deload numbers. Save the step for Meso 3, when it has to be set on the Warsaw machine. The 130 x 10 on 22 Sept was a deload set on that Warsaw machine and can't be compared with the old one.
